clearGlossaryMessage: This will delete all glossary entries. Export a JSON backup first if you want to keep them.
cloudProviderSubtitle: Select a provider to edit key, model, and activation settings
qwenSubscriptionBanner: Alibaba Cloud Token Plan subscription active — 6 text models available for polishing.
manageKeysHelp: Quickly enable all or isolate 1 key for testing
addKeyHelp: Add an additional API key for automatic quota fallback (up to 10 keys)
keyNonLatinError: Key has non-Latin characters — re-paste as ASCII.
searchModelsPlaceholder: Search models (e.g. flash, mini, qwen, gpt-4o)…
pasteFromClipboardHelp: Paste text from clipboard and auto-translate
translationWindowDesc: Opens the full translation panel with source text and result
quickTranslationDesc: Opens a minimal window showing only the translated result
localModelsHint: Download a Whisper model below and press Use — or switch to Cloud · Google Gemini. Apple Speech is not used.
googleAPIBody: Audio is uploaded to Google and processed with your selected Gemini model from API Providers (whatever you pick — e.g. 3.5 / 3.6 Flash). Variant 1/2 prompts from Settings → Prompts are applied. HUD: A/letter language control; targets 1 or 2 only (no Raw).
scanForLocalModelsBody: Search ~/Documents, ~/Downloads, and HuggingFace cache for MLX models
localPolishingSupportHint: Only text-generation MLX models with a compatible tokenizer are supported for local polishing.
removeCustomModelHelp: Removes from list only. Files on disk are not deleted.
accessibilityPermissionDescription: Required only for Type into Active App. Clipboard mode does not need Accessibility permission.
helpHeroSubtitle: Dictate anywhere on your Mac. Speech is transcribed on-device with Whisper; text can stay raw, get cleaned up, or be rewritten—then copied or typed into the app you were using.
helpStart1: Allow the microphone when macOS asks. Without it, recording cannot start.
helpStart2: Open Settings → Local Models, download a Whisper model (Large v3 Full is the best all-round choice), then press Use.
helpStart3: Open Settings → Hotkey, turn hotkeys on. Primary (default Option+S) is dictation. The Translation Window hotkey (default Option+1) opens the full floating translation panel; Quick Translation (default Option+2) shows just the result; Open Settings (default Option+~) opens preferences. For dictation pick Target (Raw / Variant 1 / Variant 2) and Mode (Clipboard or Type into Active App).
helpStart4: Optional: in API Providers add a cloud key (you can store several per provider), pick a model, star favorites, then Use for Polishing—or install a local MLX model. Without a polishing/translation engine, Variant 1/2 and non-English forced language will not improve the text.
helpStart5: Dictation: focus any app → Option+S → speak → Option+S again (red HUD = recording, green = processing). Instant translation: select text elsewhere → Option+1 → the floating panel captures selection/clipboard and translates (Option+2 shows only the result).
helpModeWindowBody: A notebook for notes: record or import audio, review Raw / Variant 1 / Variant 2, polish, translate, and copy. Best when you want to edit and keep history.
helpModeHotkeyBody: Stay inside another app. Primary hotkey (Option+S) records with the floating HUD: language mode (A / letter) and output target (R / 1 / 2). While the HUD is visible, scroll to switch the polishing provider, and right-click a provider to choose a specific model. Does not steal keyboard focus while you dictate.
helpModeFloatBody: The Translation Window hotkey (Option+1 by default) opens an always-on-top translation panel. It grabs selected text from the active app (via a quick Command-C), fills Original, and can translate immediately. Use when you need a language change without full dictation.
helpWindowBody: Left: note list. Right: the selected note—audio info, polishing provider/model menus, text tabs, and the action bar.
helpWindowNotes: Sidebar: select a note, Copy All, or Clear All (permanent: deletes every note and leftover recording files on disk).
helpWindowTabs: Tabs: Raw = pure transcript. Variant 1 = light cleanup (fillers, repeats). Variant 2 = stronger rewrite for clarity. Use the Markdown action on a polished tab to structure the text. Prompt slots D/1/2/3/4 switch which custom prompt is active for that variant.
helpWindowActions: Bottom bar: Record / Stop, Blank note, Import Audio (or drag a file onto the window), Translate, Polish, Copy. Settings opens Preferences.
helpWindowPolishingMenus: Above the editor you can switch Polishing Provider (Disabled / Quick Cleanup / local MLX / cloud) and Polishing Model (models for the selected cloud provider, or local MLX cards). This matches Settings → API Providers / Polishing without leaving the note.
helpHUDIntro: When you press the global hotkey, a small floating capsule appears over every app. It is not a normal window: it stays on top, does not steal keyboard focus, and shows only status—not the full transcript.
helpHUDAnatomy: Layout left → right: (1) language button  ·  (2) live waveform in the middle  ·  (3) output-target button. On your screen it often looks like  [ A ]  ≈≈≈  [ R ].
helpHUDColorRed: Middle waveform turns red while the microphone is recording. Speak while it is red.
helpHUDColorGreen: After you stop (hotkey again), the waveform turns green: SmartScribe is transcribing, polishing if needed, and delivering the text. Wait until the HUD hides.
helpHUDLeftA: A = Auto. SmartScribe keeps / auto-detects the language you spoke. No forced translation. Use this when you want the transcript in the same language as your speech.
helpHUDLeftLetter: A letter instead of A means “force target language.” The letter is the first letter of that language’s English name: E = English, S = Spanish, R = Russian, F = French, C = Chinese, G = German, and so on. Which letter appears depends on Settings → Hotkey → Transcription Language (or Glossary Auto Translation Language if Hotkey is Auto).
helpHUDLeftTap: Tap the left button once to switch A → letter (forced target), tap again to switch letter → A. The choice is remembered for the next session.
helpHUDRightR: R = Raw. Deliver the plain transcript with no Variant 1 / Variant 2 polishing. Fastest path; still can use Whisper English-translate when the left button is E.
helpHUDRightCycle: 1 = Variant 1 (light cleanup). 2 = Variant 2 (stronger rewrite). These need an active polishing engine (cloud or local MLX). Choosing 1 or 2 turns polishing back on if it was disabled.
helpHUDRightTap: Tap the right button to cycle R → 1 → 2 → R. The selection becomes the new default Target in Hotkey settings for future dictations.
helpHUDControlLanguage: Left: A = auto / same language as speech. Letter (E, S, R, …) = force that target language. Tap to toggle A ↔ letter.
helpHUDControlTarget: Right: R = Raw transcript, 1 = Variant 1, 2 = Variant 2. Tap to cycle R → 1 → 2 → R.
helpHUDDrag: Drag: click and hold anywhere on the capsule (not only the buttons) and move it to any place on any display. Put it near the corner, above the dock, or next to the app you type in—wherever you like.
helpHUDSize: Size & transparency: Settings → General → Overlay HUD. The Size slider scales the whole capsule (and how many spectrum bars you see). Transparency fades the glass background so desktop content shows through more or less.
helpHUDSound: Sounds: same General → Overlay HUD section. Toggle “Play sound on start/finish”, set Sound Volume, and use Test HUD Sounds to preview without recording. Cues play when recording starts and when processing finishes.
helpHUDSettingsPath: All HUD look-and-feel lives under Settings → General → Overlay HUD (size, transparency, sound, volume). Position is saved automatically after you drag.
helpHUDPosition: After you drag the HUD, SmartScribe remembers that spot and reopens there next time.
helpHUDDuration: No short artificial limit on how long you may speak. Keep talking while the waveform is red; press the hotkey again when finished.
helpLangIntro: Language control is the left HUD button plus Settings → Hotkey → Transcription Language. They work together.
helpLangAuto: A (auto): transcript stays in the language you spoke. Best for notes in your native language without translation.
helpLangForced: Letter (forced target): after speech recognition, SmartScribe aims for a specific output language. Speak Russian, get English; speak English, get Spanish—depending on the configured target.
helpLangEnglishNote: Target English + multilingual Whisper: Raw uses Whisper’s built-in translate-to-English on device (fast). Prefer Large v3 Full for quality; Turbo is lighter but less reliable on long or mixed speech.
helpLangOtherNote: Any non-English target always needs an LLM after Whisper (cloud or local MLX). Without an active polishing path, forced Spanish/Russian/… cannot convert the language.
helpLangWhere: Set the target under Hotkey → Transcription Language (English, Spanish, Russian, …). If that is Auto, letter mode uses Glossary → Auto Translation Language, then falls back to English. The HUD letter updates from that choice.
helpModelsIntro: Settings → Local Models manages WhisperKit Core ML models that turn audio into text on Apple Silicon. This is separate from polishing models.
helpModelsCatalog: English-only (Small/Medium .en): fast when you only speak English. Multilingual Small/Medium: lighter multi-language. Large v3 Turbo (~1.6 GB): fast large model. Large v3 Full (~3 GB, Best quality): recommended default for accuracy and English translate.
helpModelsRecommend: For mixed languages and forced English (HUD letter E), use a multilingual model—ideally Large v3 Full. English-only models cannot natively translate other languages into English.
helpModelsUse: Download → Use (only one active). Delete removes files from this Mac. There is no Apple Speech fallback — pick Local Whisper (with a downloaded model) or Cloud · Google Gemini (Google API key required).
helpHotkeyIntro: Settings → Hotkey enables four independent global shortcuts. Turn Enable hotkey on before any of them will fire.
helpHotkeyPrimary: Primary (default Option+S (⌥S)): start/stop dictation into the Overlay HUD. First press records (red), second press processes (green) and delivers Raw / Variant 1 / Variant 2.
helpHotkeySecondary: Translation Window (default Option+1): opens the full floating translation panel. Not a recording hotkey—it captures selection/clipboard and translates. Reset arrow restores Option+1.
helpHotkeyTertiary: Quick Translation (default Option+2): opens a minimal read-only window with just the translated result. Press the hotkey again or Escape to close it.
helpHotkeySettings: Open Settings (default Option+~): opens the SmartScribe settings window from anywhere, so you can switch models or languages without leaving your app.
helpModeQuickBody: Tertiary hotkey (Option+2 by default) opens a minimal always-on-top window that shows only the translated result—no source pane, no buttons. Read it, then press Escape to dismiss. For editing or re-translating, use the full Floating Translation Window instead.
helpFloatQuick: Two translation windows: the Floating Translation Window (Option+1) is the full panel with source text, provider/model menus, and controls; Quick Translation (Option+2) is a minimal read-only window showing only the result. Use Quick Translation when you just need to read a translation.
helpHotkeyTarget: Dictation Target: which text is delivered after recording—Raw, Variant 1, or Variant 2. Same choice as the right HUD button (R / 1 / 2).
helpHotkeyMode: Dictation Mode: Clipboard copies the result for you to paste; Type into Active App inserts into the field that was focused when recording began.
helpHotkeyAccess: Type into Active App needs Accessibility permission (same settings page). Clipboard mode and the Floating Translation Window do not require Accessibility for paste into the panel—but capturing text from other apps via Command-C works best when the app is trusted.
helpFloatIntro: A resizable, always-on-top utility panel (SmartScribe Translation) separate from the main notebook. Ideal for quick language change while you stay in browser, mail, or chat.
helpFloatHotkey: Open it with the Translation Window hotkey (Settings → Hotkey → Translation Window, default Option+1). You can also open Translate from the main window bottom bar; the floating panel shares the same UI.
helpFloatCapture: On open, SmartScribe briefly sends Command-C to the frontmost app to copy any selection, then prefers note selection if you are inside SmartScribe, otherwise clipboard text. If something was captured and a translation provider is set, translation starts automatically.
helpFloatPanel: Inside the panel: choose Provider and Model, set Target Language, edit Original, run Translate / Translate Again, or record a short clip for translation. The panel stays floating above other apps and can be resized.
helpFloatFavorites: Model list in the translation UI prefers models you starred as favorites in Settings → API Providers (searchable picker ★). If you have no favorites for that provider, the currently selected model is shown.
helpFloatDoubleClick: Double-click the Original (source) text area to paste from the clipboard and translate immediately—handy after you copy text yourself.
helpFloatEscape: Press Escape or the close button to dismiss the floating panel. Closing does not quit SmartScribe.
helpCloudIntro: Settings → API Providers configures cloud LLMs for polishing and translation—not for Whisper speech recognition. Layout: provider dropdown at the top, detail card, then usage stats.
helpCloudProviders: Dropdown order: Google Gemini → OpenAI → Qwen → OpenRouter → Custom. (Anthropic is not shown in the current UI.) Active badge marks the engine used for polishing.
helpCloudConfigure: Select a provider, enter key(s), open Browse models (searchable sheet), pick a text model, then Use for Polishing. Get API Key opens the provider’s console when available. Model chips show context length and, where available, input/output prices.
helpCloudKeys: Multiple API keys: each provider can store up to 10 keys (Add Key). Eye icon shows/hides a key. The first non-empty key is used for requests; extras help you rotate or keep personal vs work keys.
helpCloudFavorites: In the model picker, star models as favorites (★). Favorites sort to the top and are preferred in the Floating Translation Window model menu. Favorites are stored on this Mac.
helpCloudOpenRouter: OpenRouter: live account balance (color-coded remaining USD), searchable catalog with context and $/M token prices, and refresh control. Check balance before long sessions.
helpCloudBudget: OpenRouter budget slider is a personal soft limit helper in Settings (visual guide for how much you intend to spend)—it does not cut off the API by itself. Watch the real balance banner for remaining credit.
helpCloudCustom: Custom: any OpenAI-compatible Base URL + key (proxies, self-hosted, or vendor endpoints). Models load from that endpoint after the key and URL are set.
helpCloudStats: Usage stats at the bottom of API Providers: last transaction tokens and totals for the selected model. Reset Stats clears those counters.
helpPolishIntro: Transcription turns speech into text. Polishing rewrites that text. They use different models and settings.
helpPolishEngines: Engines: Polishing Disabled (Raw only) · Quick Local Cleanup (rules, no LLM, fully offline) · Local MLX model · Cloud provider from API Providers. You can switch provider/model from the main note toolbar as well as from Settings.
helpPolishMLX: Settings → Polishing: download catalog models or Scan for Local Models on disk. Prefer non-reasoning instruct models; reasoning/thinking models are slower and may leak chain-of-thought into the note.
helpPolishPrompts: Settings → Prompts: edit Variant 1, Variant 2, and Markdown. Every prompt must keep the \(PromptTemplate.transcriptionPlaceholder) placeholder. Reset restores the built-in template.
helpMoreGlossary: Glossary is a local dictionary of preferred spellings and terms (source → translation, variants, categories). It does not retrain Whisper; it rewrites text after recognition/translation. Enable it, add entries, or select text in a note → Add to Glossary. Export JSON before Clear. Auto Translation Language here backs HUD letter mode when Hotkey language is Auto.
helpMoreImport: Import Audio or drop a file on the window to create a transcribed note with the active speech model.
helpMoreTranslate: Translate from the main window or via the Option+1 floating panel (Option+2 shows just the result): selection / clipboard / live dictation → provider + model + target language. Translation changes language on purpose; Variant 1/2 keep the same language. HUD letter mode uses the translation engine when the target is not English.
helpPrivacyLocal: Whisper transcription, Quick Local Cleanup, and local MLX polishing stay on this Mac. Recordings are stored in the app’s local data folders.
helpPrivacyCloud: Cloud polishing and cloud translation send your text (and prompts) to the selected provider. Use local engines when notes must stay private.
helpPrivacyClear: Clear All permanently deletes all notes and empties the recordings folder, including orphaned audio left by interrupted sessions. Export first if you care about the content.
helpPrivacyLogs: General → Export System Logs for a diagnostic file. Use Debug log level only while troubleshooting. Theme, UI scale, HUD size/sounds, and interface language are also under General.
helpTipEnglish: Need English output from other languages? Multilingual Whisper + HUD letter E (or Transcription Language = English) + Large v3 Full.
helpTipNonEnglish: Need Spanish/Russian/… output? Set that language under Hotkey, switch HUD to the letter, and keep a cloud or MLX polishing engine active.
helpTipDisk: Disk full of models or recordings? Delete unused Whisper models in Local Models; use Clear All only when you intend to wipe notes and leftover .caf files.
helpTipStuck: Hotkey or typing stuck? Confirm Hotkey is enabled, microphone works in the main window, Accessibility is granted for Type mode, then try Refresh status. Export logs if it still fails.
helpWelcomeBody: Dictate anywhere on your Mac. Speech is transcribed on-device with Whisper; text can stay raw, get cleaned up, or be rewritten—then copied or typed into the app you were using.
helpRecordStep: Click into another app → press the hotkey (default Option+S) → speak → press again to stop. Red HUD = recording, green = processing.
helpVariantsStep: Raw is the transcript. Variant 1 is light cleanup. Variant 2 is a stronger rewrite. Markdown structures polished text.
helpCopyStep: Copy the current tab, Copy All notes from the sidebar, or deliver via hotkey Clipboard / Type into Active App.
helpHUDStep: HUD: [A|letter] waveform [R|1|2]. Tap left A↔E, right R→1→2. Drag anywhere; size/sound in General → Overlay HUD.
helpOfflineModelStep: Settings → Local Models: download WhisperKit models. Prefer Large v3 Full for quality and English translate.
helpOfflineActivateStep: Press Use on a downloaded model. Delete frees disk space. Fallback: Apple Speech.
helpImportStep: Import Audio or drag a file onto the window to transcribe as a new note.
helpTranslateStep: Translate modal: selection, clipboard, or short recording → provider + target language.
helpPolishingProviderStep: Disabled, Quick Local Cleanup, local MLX, or a cloud API provider from API Providers.
helpPromptsStep: Settings → Prompts for Variant 1, Variant 2, and Markdown. Keep the transcription placeholder.
helpHotkeyStep: Settings → Hotkey: enable Option+S, choose Target and Mode, grant Accessibility only for typing into apps.
helpMicrophoneStep: Microphone is required for recording in the window and via the HUD.
helpAccessibilityStep: Accessibility is required only for Type into Active App.
helpPermissionRefreshStep: If typing fails, refresh Accessibility in Hotkey settings or open System Settings.
helpPrivacyLocalStep: Local Whisper and local polishing stay on device.
helpLogsStep: General → Export System Logs when you need a diagnostic file.
transcriptionLanguageHint: Auto detect is best for mixed speech. Choosing a specific language enables auto-translation: speak in any language and get the result in the selected language.
localPolishingFilesHint: Use Delete on a model card to remove downloaded local model files from this Mac.
polishingDisabledHint: The app will stop after transcription and keep only the raw text.
quickLocalCleanupHint: Fast offline cleanup. It fixes spacing, capitalization, punctuation, and simple paragraph structure without using an LLM.
localMLXModelHint: Runs a downloaded MLX model fully on this Mac for stronger rewriting without sending text to a cloud provider.
apiPolishingHint: Uses the configured external provider for polishing. This can be stronger, but it sends text to that API.
hotkeyDescription: Hotkey + Shift records speech, then translates to the Auto Translation Language configured in Glossary. Hotkey alone keeps auto-detected transcription.
hotkeySecondaryDesc: Transcribes speech and translates to the Glossary Auto Translation Language.
googleProviderSubtitle: Gemini API key and text model for cloud polishing.
customProviderSubtitle: Use providers such as OpenRouter or a private OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
chooseLocalPolishingModel: Choose and download a local polishing model in Settings.
createOrSelectNote: Create or select a note to begin.
translationOriginalPlaceholder: Paste or type text to translate.
noTextToTranslate: No text to translate. Copy text to clipboard or select text in a note and try again.
noTranscriptToPolish: No transcript is available to polish.
unsupportedAudioFormat: This audio format is not supported by the macOS system decoder.
microphoneAccessDisabled: Microphone access is disabled for SmartScribe.
audioInputNoDevice: No audio input device is connected. Connect a microphone and refresh.
missingAudioFileForTranscription: No audio file was provided for transcription.
speechPermissionDisabled: Speech recognition permission is disabled for SmartScribe.
appleSpeechOnDeviceUnavailableForLocale: On-device Apple Speech recognition is unavailable for %@.
appleSpeechReturnedEmptyTranscript: Apple Speech returned an empty transcript.
modelDownloadedLoadsOnFirstUse: %@ is downloaded. Loads automatically on first use.
chooseLocalPolishingModelShort: Choose and download a local polishing model.
onboardingChooseLanguageHint: You can change this anytime in Settings → General.
onboardingHowToTranscribe: How do you want to transcribe?
onboardingLocalBody: On-device, private, works offline. Download a model once and you're set.
onboardingCloudBody: No downloads. Transcription, polishing, and translation via Google Gemini API.
onboardingSetupLocalBody: Go to Settings → Local Models, download a Whisper model, then press Use.
onboardingSetupCloudBody: Go to Settings → API Providers, select Google, enter your API key, and choose a model.
onboardingPermissionsBody: SmartScribe needs two permissions to work properly.
onboardingAccessibility: Accessibility — to insert text into other apps and capture hotkeys.
onboardingModesBody: Main window for notes and editing. Hotkey + HUD for dictating in any app. Option+1 for the full translation panel, Option+2 for a quick result-only window.
onboardingGlossaryBody: Create a glossary for %@ to improve accuracy of names and special terms.
onboardingThemeBody: Choose a theme. You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboardingLanguageNote: Interface language: %@. Change anytime in Settings → General.
helpCloudTranscriptionBody: Select Cloud · Google in the transcription menu, add your Google API key in Settings → API Providers, and you're done — no local model download required.
